## Problem

What are you trying to do that fino makes hard or impossible today?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see.

## Does it belong in the core?

fino keeps a deliberately minimal core: a capability is added only if it is
part of the ReAct loop **and** cannot be implemented cleanly via a Tool,
Policy, Hook, Mode, Model, or code around the Runner (see
[`docs/design.md`](../../docs/design.md)). If you've already tried to solve
this by composition, describe what didn't work.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you weighed.
